reported, citing people familiar with the matter.
The discussions began before Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei called Saturday for AI companies to coordinate on testing and auditing.

Meanwhile, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman has also told employees he supports creating such an organization, but believes major AI labs would need to establish it without U.S. government support, according to the report.
The working group meetings involving Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google are ongoing, the report added. The group met as recently as last week.
